lede: Wat  Cedi Luang Worawihan accounts for 59 catalogued manuscripts, 4 of them flagged research-priority. It clusters in Chiang Mai (98% of the corpus for this temple), ahead of Mueang District. Nearly all (100%) are written in Tham Lanna · อักษรธรรมล้านนา script. By support it leans to palm-leaf · ใบลาน (93%) over mulberry paper (saa) · กระดาษสา (7%). Dated witnesses run 1761–1906 CE (34 of 59 carry a date).
